subject: general
question:
Identify the number that will replace the question mark (?) in the second equation based on the relationship represented in the first equation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ae5148eb3cd9ee5f91651c57063af2b0756c64a028330914d0cf55963a56bde.png]
solution:
**The logic followed here is: **Power → (Number of circles + 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea11206f942948f2fe6431dccdd1c693d677e5dc769fa37944146a969ce2e190.png] 

a → (1 circle + 1) ⇒ a2

b → (2 circles + 1) ⇒ b3

c → (2 circles + 1) ⇒ c4

⇒ a2 + b3 + c4

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6baa7d6a61942faf5ef53ef22c29933d2185ac0f239a87f494c661a1268d668e.png] 

6 → (2 circles + 1) ⇒ 6³

3 → (3 circles + 1) ⇒ 3⁴

2 → (4 circles + 1) ⇒ 2⁵

⇒ 63 + 34 + 25

⇒ 216 + 81 + 32

**⇒329**

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
